case: bad-prefix
total bytes: 20

offset 0 .. 20: 0xFF repeated — pickle_header_size (bytes 0..4) decodes to
0xFFFFFFFF, which is not 4, so parse_prefix rejects it as Malformed at check 1,
before any of the other three words are interpreted.

Expected: Detected, 0 installations, 1 Error (Malformed).
